assets.label: Cash, interbank and central bank deposits

liabilities.label: Bank deposits, repos and bonds issued

balance.note: A bank's balance sheet is mostly other people's money: customer deposits fund the loans. Shareholders' funds are about 9% of assets, which is why capital ratios matter.

safety.label: CET1 capital ratio
safety.plain: The bank's own capital as a cushion against losses, as a share of its risk-weighted loans. Bank Negara's minimum is 4.5% plus buffers. As printed in the report's capital note; some banks print it before deducting the proposed dividend.

safety.label: Total capital ratio
safety.plain: All qualifying capital as a share of risk-weighted loans; the regulatory minimum is 8% plus buffers.

safety.label: Gross impaired loans
safety.plain: Loans in trouble as a share of all loans. Lower is better.

safety.label: Loan loss allowance coverage
safety.plain: Money already set aside for losses, compared with the troubled loans. Above 100% means fully covered.

safety.label: Loan to deposit ratio
safety.plain: The bank lends out about RM95 of every RM100 deposited.

safety.label: CASA ratio
safety.plain: Share of deposits in current and savings accounts, which pay little interest and keep funding cheap.

safety.label: Liquidity coverage ratio
safety.plain: Cash and easy-to-sell assets against 30 days of stressed outflows; the minimum is 100%.

metrics.label: Market value
metrics.plain: What the whole company costs at today's share price: RM33.3 billion.

metrics.label: P/E (last 12 months)
metrics.plain: You pay about RM10 for every RM1 of yearly profit. A high number means investors expect growth.

metrics.label: EPS (last 12 months)
metrics.plain: Profit earned for each share you own over the last year.

metrics.label: Dividend yield (dividends paid in the last 12 months)
metrics.plain: For every RM100 of shares, about RM6.6 a year comes back as cash dividends.

metrics.label: Payout ratio
metrics.plain: Of every RM100 profit, about RM63 is paid out; the rest is kept to grow.

metrics.label: Price to book
metrics.plain: The share price is 1.0 times the accounting value of what shareholders own.

metrics.label: Return on equity (last 12 months)
metrics.plain: For every RM100 shareholders have in the company, it earned about RM10 profit last year.

metrics.label: Net margin 1H2026
metrics.plain: What is left as profit for shareholders from every RM100 of revenue: RM38.19.

metrics.label: Revenue growth 1H2026
metrics.plain: Revenue compared with the same period a year earlier.

metrics.label: Profit growth 1H2026
metrics.plain: Profit to shareholders compared with the same period a year earlier.

metrics.label: Cost to income (1H2026)
metrics.plain: Of every RM100 of income, about RM47 is spent on staff, branches and IT. Lower is more efficient.

metrics.label: Credit cost (1H2026, annualised)
metrics.plain: Provisions for bad loans equal to 0.14% of loans a year. Lower is better.

drivers.evidence: Net funding income rose 5.3% to RM3.14bn in 1H2026 on 7.0% loan growth and lower funding cost (Q B1)
drivers.why: Its main income line is growing.

drivers.evidence: Non-fund based income fell 0.4% to RM1.22bn on lower FX gains (Q B1)
Gross loans up 7.0% to RM258.3bn, led by mortgages, Singapore, corporate, commercial and auto (Q B1)
Provisions of RM170m in 1H2026 against RM195m a year earlier (database)
Gross impaired loans ratio 1.47% against 1.51% a year earlier (Q B1)
CASA was 27.6% of deposits; growth came mostly from money-market deposits (+31.8%) (Q B1)
drivers.why: More expensive deposits can squeeze margins.

drivers.evidence: CET1 capital ratio of about 15.2% (Q notes)

outlook.text: Malaysia's economy expected to stay resilient in 2H2026 on domestic demand, investment and a stable labour market (Q B3).
Banking sector resilient; monetary policy expected to stay data-dependent and broadly stable (Q B3).
Key risks from Middle East tensions and US-led trade tariffs (Q B3).

outlookOverall.text: Cautiously optimistic: focused on its PROGRESS27 priorities, balancing growth with prudent risk management (Q B3).
